# Koodh Media Group

Koodh Media Group creates audio branding for radio and captures the energy of live events through photography. The team helps radio stations and events sound and look unforgettable.

## Services

- Radio imaging: sweepers, station IDs, promos and show elements
- Jingles and music beds, written together with the client
- Event and festival photography, with fast delivery of edited highlights
- Drone photography and video of events, buildings and landscapes

Work covers radio stations, festivals and live events across the Netherlands and Belgium.

## Pages

- / — homepage: selected work, services, team and contact
- /nieuws/<slug> — individual news articles and project stories, served from the Clara news API
